description.value: A cross-sectional MRI study examining cortical and subcortical brain morphology in adolescents with alcohol use disorders without psychiatric or substance-use comorbidities compared with matched controls.

spans.text: In this report, we present the effects of heavy drinking on cortical and subcortical volumes in South African adolescents with AUDs.
